name: ilm
description: Ilm — school management platform (auth, academic, notification services + admin SPA)

scripts.dev: concurrently --names auth,academic,classroom,admin --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @ilm/auth-service" "npm run dev --workspace @ilm/academic-service" "npm run dev --workspace @ilm/classroom-service" "npm run dev --prefix apps/admin"
scripts.test: concurrently --max-processes 1 --names auth,academic,classroom --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm exec --workspace @ilm/auth-service -- vitest run src/" "npm exec --workspace @ilm/academic-service -- vitest run src/" "npm exec --workspace @ilm/classroom-service -- vitest run src/"
